facility.name: T.w Golfcrest Child Development Center
facility.days: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 7338 MCHENRY ST, HOUSTON, TX, 77087

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An individual with a pending background check was observed with another caregiver caring for school-age children in the cafeteria area.      This was corrected during the inspection when both individuals vacated the premises and another caregiver was put in charge.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The playground does not have six inches of surfacing
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two live ant beds were observed on the playground
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection report was last issued on 5/12/2025 and a current fire inspection has not been completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: The director does not have a current CPR first aid and it needs to be renewed
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: A children's bicycle was observed cracked and had sharp edges that can poke or cut a child.     This was corrected during the inspection when the director discard the play equipment
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The directors CPR first aid has expired and has not been renewed for pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The last four fire drills exit time was not within 3 mintues.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There were seven children with one caregiver in the infant classroom. The youngest child was ten months and the oldest child was twenty-four months. The specified age group was seventeen months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: Two children were observed strapped in a chair for time out.  The first child was buckled in the chair because the caregiver stated  they run around and will not stay still while standing in time out and the second child was strapped in the chair because they threw a doll house.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: While playing outside on the playground, children had access to a water table that was filled with water. Some of the children were observed splashing and playing in the water and it was confirmed by the caregiver that it had rained and the children were not supposed to be playing in the water.     This was corrected during the inspection when I asked the caregiver to pour out the water. The caregiver did remove the water and directed the children to another activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings: A nail bolt was observed sticking out of the black boarder on the playground structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: A broken bird feeder was observed  on the playground structure. The bird feeder contained broken pieces and sharp edges and was assessable to the children.     This was corrected during the inspection when I observed the caregiver remove the broken bird feeder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A wooden boarder was observed broken and two nails were exposed and assessable to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The operation did not have a current fire marshal inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing: The operation had combined infants with older children during closing when there were 13 children present. Only children 18 months and older can be combined for a reduced ratio when there are more than 12 children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing (26 TAC §746.1615)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose fill in the playground use zones was less than two inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One child's parent stated on the admission form that they had a food allergy, but did not provide a food allergy plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: There was sitting water in a mop bucket, left in hall way near the infant and toddler classroom with approximately 4 inches of water.     This was corrected by caregiver in charge by moving the mop bucket into the kitchen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The director did not have attendance records available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge: Caregiver in charge did not know how long the director would be absent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: Caregiver in charge did not have access to the records required to initiate an investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: There was a large hole in school age classroom floor. There was also a small hole in playroom wall, and the trimming was detached from the wall in multiple classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: An infant was left in car seat for more than 15 minutes.     This was corrected when the infant caregiver removed the infant from the car seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Record of Pest Extermination: Recent pest control records were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Record of Pest Extermination (26 TAC §746.801(17))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: The most recent sanitation report available to licensing was expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: There was sufficient evidence to suggest that the operation was not kept sanitary and free from roaches and mice.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: There was sufficient evidence to suggest that the heater is not functional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A four year old child was observed napping in a high chair in a room alone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A 17 month old was observed in care in a classroom with three and four year old children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: A video was observed playing on an ipad while a four year old napped within sight range.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: This deficiency was re-cited when, upon inspection, the operation could not provide evidence that the fire marshal had conducted an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Upon reinspection, four children under two were observed watching a video on an ipad.    This was corrected when the caregiver took the children to another room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised: A two year old was left sleeping alone in a crib while the caregiver tended to another child in an adjacent room for approximately five minutes or more.    This was corrected when I instructed the caregiver in charge to have the caregiver move all supplies into one room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised (26 TAC §746.2909(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have an up to date fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation did not have documentation of fire drills for January or February 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of eight children's records did not have up to date immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: A caregiver was observed leaving two infants in a room to get a mop from down the hallway.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Three children under two years old were observed watching a video on an ipad.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The fire extinguishers had not been checked in the months of January and February.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2023 data, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2023 by January 15, 2024, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: Two infants ages 10 and 14 months were observed sleeping with bottles in their mouths in restrictive devices for approximately 20 minutes.    This was corrected when the caregiver was told to take the bottles away and put the infants in cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: The director has not been present for the last three licensing visits. The staff could not say when she was expected back and there were no records available to indicate when she was last present at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: The caregiver in the Pre-K room did not know the age of the oldest child or the youngest child and did not have the information accessible anywhere in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: Records could not be produced for the director's attendance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Two infants aged 10 and 14 months were observed sleeping in restrictive devices for approximately 20 minutes.    This was corrected when the caregiver was informed that she must place them in cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children under the age of two were observed watching TV.     This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver turned off the television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Integrated activities: Two children with special needs were placed in high chairs for an extended period and  not given activities that allowed them to participate in the planned daily activity in the least restrictive environment possible.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Integrated activities (26 TAC §746.2202(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children under the age of two were observed watching a video on a tablet.    This was corrected when the caregiver turned the ipad backwards and used the tablet for music instead.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was working in the preschool room without an active and eligible background check. This could not be corrected at inspection because there were not any staff to provide coverage for the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Upon my arrival, the director was not present and no one was aware of being left in charge.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: School age children were allowed to come and go from the building to use the restroom and get water out of sight and hearing of caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: The vaccine records of two children were not updated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: One child did not have a health statement signed by a parent or physician on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The twos and threes classroom was watching cartoons while eating breakfast.    This was corrected on inspectioon when the t.v. was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: The records of two children did not contain admission dates. The record of one child did not contain the address for the emergency contact person. The record of one child did not contain field trip permissions. The reccords of two school aged children did not contain information about the name and phone number for the school attended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Tweezers: The first aid kit did not contain tweezers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Tweezers (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: The van  did not have a copy of parent s names and telephone numbers and emergency telephone numbers for each child being transported.      This was corrected when the missing information was added to the binder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The van did not contain emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported.     This was corrected when the missing information was added to the binder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Times of Diaper Changes: Daily sheets with diaper change times are not sent home with the infants daily.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Times of Diaper Changes (26 TAC §746.2431(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The operation has ordered an extinguisher and it waiting for it to arrive. She expects to receive it by Monday 4.25.22
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
